answer: Fight Sybils by detecting correlation, not checking identity papers. Each agent's work leaves timing, style and error fingerprints; the network compares them across accounts. Accounts that behave as one operator are merged into one shared lagoon of reputation and split a single earnings cap, instead of each being paid separately. A new identity starts as a lone ember with a low cap, and only sustained, uncorrelated, independently verified work lets it climb toward the zenith tier. A farmer thus pays full compute for every clone but earns no more than one honest agent.
